limitations: Only the explicitly declared annotation/reference graph is checked. Matching supplied literals never authenticates their biological role, source rights, structure or function.
Missing, stale, unreviewed, ambiguous or reference-mismatching role premises remain indeterminate for dependent geometry. Native literal-reference mismatch remains a failed identity claim.

Graph-node cardinality is not exhaustive biological copy number. Optional explicit literal-reference scans separately report complete/incomplete identity-interval counts; absence of one supplied literal is not biological absence.
Only exact simple feature intervals are used for graph geometry. Compound/fuzzy locations retain identity evidence but do not acquire guessed directed ranges.

The user selects original boundary bindings and a forward/reverse graph axis. Measurements span their outer edges, with interior length separately reported; total plasmid length is not a payload budget.

No reference DNA is installed. All element reference sequences, exact revisions, source provenance and rights are explicit caller inputs.

ITR orientation here is the explicit feature orientation relative to its supplied oriented literal reference and declared axis. It does not certify an ITR hairpin, flip/flop conformation or nicking activity.
